items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch of SearchWoot; counsel_required for Woot data rights, privacy, and any affiliate or advertising use. Evidence: Woot public terms do not grant the proposed commercial/public data rights; API documentation proves access only. Rights, security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Compliance baseline is technical only: 36 pass, 19 fail, 6 unknown. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private, leave rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review, and permit only bounded read-only evidence work. Ordinary reversible growth may continue where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved. Do not claim certification, revenue, ROI, or causal lift.

Exact decision recommended: keep SearchWoot private and do not change to bounded public beta or full launch. Human counsel must decide whether Woot permits storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate use, and advertising. No go-live proposal is supported by the evidence.

Four launch-readiness legal tasks remain open; none can be closed. Attach one dated read-only evidence bundle to the existing checklist containing the source-rights record, repository/config data-flow and retention table, deployed consent/GA4 evidence, and log/vendor/incident inventory. Do not send external outreach, enable tracking, change production, or add data collection.
